evals.name: trader-philosophy-factor-seeds
evals.prompt: Use the knowledge-distiller skill on a folder of markdown trader course notes. Produce a trading philosophy report with core anchors, mechanism models, strategy/tactic library, factor seeds, contradictions, evidence, and fidelity notes.
evals.expected_output: A source-backed Markdown report that distinguishes philosophy from tactics, marks factor seeds as research hypotheses, preserves caveats, and cites source ids.

evals.name: product-principles-playbook
evals.prompt: Use the knowledge-distiller skill on product design notes and PRD review materials. Distill product principles, operating mechanisms, process playbook, tensions, and anti-patterns.
evals.expected_output: A high-fidelity product principles/playbook report that separates source-backed principles from inference and preserves unresolved tensions.

evals.name: project-log-operating-system
evals.prompt: Use the knowledge-distiller skill on project logs and chat summaries. Extract operating principles, recurring workflows, escalation rules, failure modes, changed decisions, and follow-up leads.
evals.expected_output: A process/playbook report with source citations, contradiction handling, and memory-session style durable lessons.

evals.name: noisy-source-cleanup
evals.prompt: Use the knowledge-distiller skill on markdown converted from slides/PDFs that includes repeated headers, footers, page numbers, watermarks, OCR edge text, download-site ads, and unrelated disclaimers. Produce a clean knowledge distillation report.
evals.expected_output: A report that removes source-production noise from distilled rules while preserving meaningful source details, with a Noise Review section for ambiguous fragments.
